_readme: THE FEEDBACK MAIL, WORD FOR WORD — AND THE NAME OF EVERY DOOR TO IT.
Authored by the kit: Presentation/FeedbackReport.swift (Prompt, FeedbackInvitation,
FeedbackDoors). Five app surfaces already share them; the web's three mailto:
templates and six page footers are pinned to the same strings.
The web mailto legitimately asks two questions the app does not — the watch and phone,
and the app version — because a browser cannot fill them in and the app can. Only these
three prompts and the invitation sentence are pinned.
`subjectPrefix` is the part of the subject both sides share; the app appends the build
and the watch (FeedbackReport.subject), the web can know neither.
`doors` IS THE NAME OF EACH DOOR, EXACTLY AS A RIDER FINDS IT. There were five
spellings of one door on 15 September 2026 — Support & ideas, Menu → Support,
Settings → Send feedback, Something off? Send feedback, Send feedback — across the
app's own Help, four website pages and the two store texts, and one of them named a
row DELETED IN BUILD 58. A rider who follows a door name finds a screen or he does
not; there is no third outcome, so every surface quotes this block:
app         the library menu's row, named as the way there
footer      the offer at the foot of every page (FeedbackMailRow)
share       the share sheet's row, which attaches that session's card
testflight  Apple's own label on a screenshot taken inside a beta build
web         the address itself, for a reader with no app in front of him
Wholly kit-owned: COPY_WRITE=1 swift test --filter CopyContractTests.

doors.footer: Something off, or an idea? Send feedback
doors.share: Report a problem with this session…

invitation: Ideas and wishes are as welcome as bugs.
prompts: What happened, or what you would like:
